p5_b0.ocr: In the realm of healthcare services and medical technology, understanding the surgical procedure mix is vital for optimizing resource allocation and improving patient outcomes. This report presents a comprehensive analysis of the surgical procedures performed by Fresenius SE, focusing on key metrics such as the number of procedures completed and the associated financial implications.

p5_b1.ocr: The data table delineates the distribution of surgical interventions, specifically highlighting areas such as Cardiac Surgery and Orthopedic Surgery, which represent significant components of our operational portfolio. In the past fiscal year, the organization successfully completed 1,200 cardiac surgeries, generating a substantial revenue of CAD 15 million. This translates to an impressive average revenue of CAD 12,500 per procedure, underscoring the high value associated with cardiac interventions.

This segment showcases the diversification of our surgical offerings, allowing us to cater to a wider demographic while maintaining a focus on quality care. The combination of these surgical specialties not only enhances our service portfolio but also contributes to our overall financial health.
